checks: Local search filters the installed catalogue without launching a process or allocating managed pages for each key
Enter launches the original installed Calculator from its catalogue identity
Default categories filter actual installed apps while keeping the Start menu open
Create, rename, hide and reorder update bounded real category preferences
Context category assignment persists; a hidden category does not remove its app from search
Start pins can be renamed and reordered without renaming or removing the installed app
App context actions persist independent Start and taskbar pins
Taskbar alignment is configurable; the default-layout review initially selects Cancel
Pinned launchers and actual window buttons separately launch, minimize and restore the same real window
A native folder pin follows a real folder rename, then opens the actual renamed folder
Optional app removal prunes both pin sets and live search; reinstall does not create stale launch paths
Power confirmation refuses unsaved documents and keeps the session running
Actual confirmed installed restart boots the same build and restores independently checked custom preferences
Confirmed Restore defaults resets layout only and preserves the user folder
Confirmed ACPI S5 shuts down the actual owned QEMU guest rather than displaying a fake power screen
Detached disk startup preserves the installed OS, restored preferences and user folder after shutdown
